topic: murder of Hindu youth Tarun Kumar by Islamists in Delhi
crisis_alert_message: HIGH - Communal tensions exploding in Uttam Nagar after Tarun Kumar lynching; protests spreading, bulldozer actions and HC intervention fueling outrage
future_emotion_forecast: Anger expected to rise by 32% in next 6 hours with planned Delhi-wide protests and calls for encounters gaining momentum
narrative_summary: Delhi's social media is on fire after 26-year-old Hindu youth Tarun Kumar was beaten to death in Uttam Nagar during Holi over a water balloon dispute that escalated into an alleged mob attack by the neighbouring Muslim family. Right-wing users are demanding Yogi-style justice with encounters and full demolitions, accusing the accused of playing the victim card and media of false 'molester' narrative. Police have arrested 16 including minors with partial bulldozer action already done, but Delhi HC halted further demolitions; fears of wider communal clashes and questions on Delhi govt's silence dominate discussions.
